Paraphrased review of Terms of Use, Content and Using our Services:
The user is responsible for necessary input rights. OpenAI assigns its rights,
if any, in generated output to the user to the extent allowed by law. Output
may be nonunique; this does not grant rights in third-party material. The
service may not be used to infringe others' rights, and generated output must
not be misrepresented as human-generated.

The Service Terms were reviewed as supplemental terms. This archive does not
determine the user's account-specific governing agreement or establish the
copyright status of an AI-generated image. No separate image-output credit
requirement was identified in the inspected sections. Record this asset's AI
origin; do not interpret that observation as a release-clearance guarantee.

Project status: concept review only. REF-001's creator and release permissions
remain unverified. REF-006 was used only for general sheet organization and
is retained as a development reference with its visible credit intact.
Commercial game use, inclusion in a released build, modification permissions
and required notices for the supplied references remain unverified.

No downloaded commercial art or additional font files were added. The new

Keep this record and source archives for development provenance. Recheck the
